# Burhan Riaz

> Senior Software Engineer (.NET and Angular) in Lahore, Pakistan, with 5 years of experience building secure, scalable web applications with ASP.NET Core, C#, Angular, SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Open to on-site or remote roles. Author of br-web-seo, an open-source SEO auditing skill for AI agents.

## Experience
- Senior Software Engineer, NODLAYS, Lahore (Mar 2024 – present): Azure AD B2C and role-based access across .NET Core APIs and Angular, Clean Architecture over a legacy database, REST APIs, Dapper and SQL Server, Microsoft Graph API
- Associate Software Engineer, NODLAYS (Mar 2023 – Feb 2024): Stripe subscriptions and webhooks, SignalR, document generation, user management
- Junior .NET Developer, JMM Technologies, Peshawar (Jan 2022 – Feb 2023): Hysabat ERP modules (Sales, Purchase, HR) with ASP.NET Core 6, GraphQL, PostgreSQL
